device_assignment: outer fold n -> cuda_devices[(n-1) mod 2]; all candidates and the selected rerun stay on that device
tensorflow_library_policy: prepend sys.prefix/lib to LD_LIBRARY_PATH before every TensorFlow subprocess
f1_threshold_rule: maximum inner-validation F1 over 100 thresholds; lowest-threshold tie break
candidate_test_policy: no outer-test prediction or metric may be materialised
selected_test_policy: freeze all five fold decisions first; then evaluate exactly one selected model per outer fold
historical_outer_test_context: The same seed-42 outer folds already have a pre-existing alpha=1 baseline result. This selector never reads those scores, but these folds are not a pristine previously unseen holdout.
